# MoldStud

> > MoldStud is a technology company and recruitment platform specializing in remote software engineering positions across full-stack development, data engineering, DevOps, and AI roles.

MoldStud connects talented developers with remote opportunities worldwide, featuring positions in modern technology stacks including React, TypeScript, Python, AWS, and various data platforms. The company is led by Co-CEO Valeriu Crudu and focuses on senior-level and specialized technical roles across healthcare, fintech, e-commerce, and enterprise software sectors.

## Key Topics

- Remote software engineering positions
- Full-stack development (React, TypeScript, Node.js)
- Cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP)
- Data engineering and analytics (SQL, Snowflake, Python)
- DevOps and microservices architecture
- Healthcare technology solutions
- Backend development (Java, Golang, C#, Python)
- RESTful APIs and distributed systems
- Business Intelligence (Tableau, Looker, Power BI)
- Artificial Intelligence and machine learning
- Docker and containerization
- Senior and lead engineering roles
- Salesforce and enterprise platforms
- Database technologies (MySQL, NoSQL)
- JavaScript ecosystem and frameworks
